plainTranslation: Mind meets gravity. The Saturn person brings focus, depth, and seriousness to the Mercury person's thinking; ideas get disciplined and built into something real. At worst, the Saturn person criticizes or silences the Mercury person, who starts to feel stupid or unheard. Failure mode: one mind policing the other. Great for serious work; never let it shrink anyone's voice.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
